name: The Freshman
source:
A romance story surrounding a young woman who attends a very prestigious college and encounters numerous challenges in life and love as she coasts her way through school. 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Freshman]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
這個愛情故事圍繞一位就讀於知名大學的年輕女子展開。在度過校園生活的過程中，她遇到了生活與愛情中的重重挑戰。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Freshman]Choices Wikia[/url]]
